newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Crude liquor kills 13 Pakistani drinkers.
newsitem.headline: Crude liquor kills 13 Pakistani drinkers.

text.p: Thirteen Pakistanis died on Monday and a dozen more were in hospital in critical condition after drinking illegally distilled liquor, police and doctors said.
Doctors said the victims had refused to disclose what they had taken because drinking by Moslems is punishable by flogging under Pakistan's Islamic laws.
Police found they had drunk liquor sold by an illegal local distillery.
